scientific_integrity: Exact integral proof using two full acyclic discrete-Morse matchings and signed boundary determinants; standalone verifier recomputes all finite evidence.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result only for the four-dimensional cube and induced vertex-linear forests at level two; no family theorem or persistent inclusion maps; no external independent audit.
title: The second forest complex of the four-cube is a wedge of \(129\) six-spheres
